title: An Egypt special for The Travel Diaries
subject: An Egypt special for The Travel Diaries
body:
Hi Holly,

The Travel Diaries already makes destination specials, from Queensland to Saudi Arabia. Egypt could be a natural next one.

One idea: an episode recorded on location, with the guest of your choosing, at Giza at first light, at the Grand Egyptian Museum, or on the Nile between Luxor and Aswan. NOYA, a UK-based concierge and destination management company specialising in Egypt, would handle locations, permissions, stays and movement on the ground.

Would it be worth a short call to see if it fits your plans for next year?

Best,
Adam Elshazly
Founder, NOYA Concierge
noyaconcierge.com

sources.fact: A weekly interview series in which journalist Holly Rubenstein talks to a guest about their travels; hosted on Acast.
The show makes destination specials, including Queensland with Matt Tebbutt (May 2026) and Saudi Arabia.
CRM note says the show is now filmed for video; not confirmed on public record.
The opening of the Grand Egyptian Museum has given Cairo a new cultural landmark.
Pyramids of Giza · Grand Egyptian Museum · Cairo · El Gouna and the Red Sea · North Coast · Luxor and Aswan.
